name: @pipeworx/mcp-eodhd

tools.name: eodhd_fundamentals
tools.description: Get fundamentals + analyst price target & estimates for <symbol> — company profile, highlights, valuation ratios, analyst ratings/target price, and forward EPS/revenue estimates. Symbol uses EXCHANGE.SUFFIX format, e.g. "AAPL.US". Example: eodhd_fundamentals({ symbol: "AAPL.US", _apiKey: "your-api_token" })

_apiKey.description: EODHD api_token (get one free at eodhd.com; free tier 20 calls/day)

tools.name: eodhd_eod_prices
tools.description: Get historical daily prices for <symbol> — end-of-day OHLCV plus adjusted close. Symbol uses EXCHANGE.SUFFIX format, e.g. "AAPL.US". Optionally bound with from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) and period (d/w/m). Example: eodhd_eod_prices({ symbol: "AAPL.US", from: "2024-01-01", to: "2024-06-30", _apiKey: "your-api_token" })

_apiKey.description: EODHD api_token (get one free at eodhd.com; free tier 20 calls/day)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eodhd forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eodhd pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
